principle: Expected values are never produced by the generator. Oracle extraction lives in generator/audit/b02_oracle_extract_v0_4_2.py, which imports nothing from the generator. Where no frozen artifact exists the record says TASK_TRANSCRIPT_ONLY and no artifact oracle is claimed.

whatsapp_screenshot_evidence.note: No screenshot or exported chat is frozen in the repository. Every 1 August 2026 ruling is TASK_TRANSCRIPT_ONLY and is NOT represented as a hash-locked artifact oracle.

records.oracle_locator: slide 14, shape paragraph "[Visual:  Promenade Tasik Titiwangsa, KL]"

records.unresolved_limitation: The frozen exemplar writes "[Visual:  ...]" with a double space; the generated deck uses a single space. Conformance is asserted on the SUBJECT, not byte-exact, and the whitespace difference is disclosed rather than silently normalised.
